title: Evaluation of a Multiplication Gate
statement: Let $F$ be a commutative ring, let $v$ assign an element of $F$ to each input index, and let $a,b$ be arithmetic circuits. Evaluating the circuit formed by multiplying $a$ and $b$ gives the product of their evaluations: $(ab)(v)=a(v)b(v)$.
hypotheses_covered: The coefficient structure is a commutative ring
An input assignment and two circuits are given
